rent_citation: Kidder Mathews, Peninsula Industrial Market Report, Q3 2026, San Mateo submarket asking NNN rent. https://kidder.com/market-reports/peninsula-industrial-market-report/
energy_citation: PG&E Schedule B-10 rates effective 2026-03-01, the rates used in docs/research/dcf_design.md section 2.
notes: Energy and demand charges are the PG&E B-10 fallback used for every ZIP until an EIA or OpenEI rate is wired. estimate() does not read rent or wage from this file.

Rent comes from the rent resolver. Wage is the ZIP's CBSA OEWS May 2025 SOC 49-3023 mean, or the national row for a micropolitan or non-metro ZIP. The hourly fallback is used only when no OEWS row exists.
Public sources only. Nothing here is Tesla internal data.
